name: ponytail
description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.
one_liner: A free add-on that makes AI coding assistants write much less, simpler code by reusing what's already in your project instead of inventing new stuff.
buyer: A startup CTO paying a monthly AI coding bill who wants smaller, cheaper, easier-to-maintain code out of the same AI agent — without hiring a senior engineer to review every line.
business_use_cases: A small dev shop installs it across client projects so AI-generated code stays lean, cutting the hours spent later cleaning up bloated AI output.
A solo indie developer uses it to keep an AI-built app maintainable as it grows, avoiding a rewrite six months in.
A coding bootcamp or course teaches it as a 'how to actually use AI agents well' module, since it visibly changes output quality.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'AI code audit' service that re-runs a client's existing AI-generated codebase through this skill and reports the savings in code size and token cost.
The project itself is building toward a paid product (per its own waitlist); a third party could instead sell training/workshops on using it well inside teams.

steal_this: Ship a tiny SaaS dashboard that runs this skill's benchmark (lines of code, tokens, cost) on a team's own repo before/after and sells the before/after report as a lead magnet for an AI-coding consultancy.
